people.name: Adullam
people.line: A Canaanite city, later fortified by Judah.

people.name: Azekah
people.line: Judean town, site of battles and sieges.

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Topheth
people.line: Site of pagan child sacrifice, south of Jerusalem

people.name: Zanoah
people.line: A town in the Judean lowlands allotted to Judah

translations.web: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.
translations.bsb: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages; in Lachish and its fields; and in Azekah and its villages. So they settled from Beersheba all the way to the Valley of Hinnom.
translations.kjv: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
translations.asv: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and the fields thereof, Azekah and the towns thereof. So they encamped from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
